query: SELECT sc.id, sc.subscription_id, sc.type, sc.amount, sc.due_date, sc.status, sc.asaas_charge_id, ac.name FROM subscription_charges sc JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Lucas%' ORDER BY sc.due_date DESC LIMIT 20;
